description: Unkey provides API Management for issuing and verifying API keys, rate limits, permissions, analytics, and customer portals, plus Compute for deploying and running apps behind a gateway. It also offers workspace tooling such as root keys, audit logs, billing and usage controls.
summary: Unkey exposes a bearer-authenticated HTTP API at api.unkey.com, a shell CLI (`unkey`) that can use either device-login sessions or a root key, and two hosted MCP servers on mcp.unkey.com authenticated by a root key header.
